mapper.update: UPDATE diary SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, tags = #{tags, typeHandler=com.otoluudiary.handler.JsonStringListTypeHandler}, weather = #{weather}, mood = #{mood}, importance = #{importance}, location = #{location}, background_image = #{backgroundImage}, diary_date = #{diaryDate}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
